request.story_prompt:
Maya is a young girl who enters a mysterious forest alone. Deep inside the forest, she discovers an old Game Machine near a huge tree.
Curious, Maya touches the machine.
Suddenly—
“GAME START!” 🎮
The forest gates close, and Maya becomes trapped inside the game.
🔴 Level 1 – Forest Run
Maya must run through the dark forest while a terrifying shadow chases her. She avoids dangerous obstacles and successfully completes Level 1.
🟠 Level 2 – Mystery House
Maya enters an abandoned house filled with mysterious puzzles. She must solve the puzzles and find the correct exit before the game resets.
Using her intelligence, Maya completes Level 2.
🟢 Level 3 – Final Choice
Maya reaches the final room. On a table, she finds two cards:
1️⃣ LOSE
2️⃣ WIN
A mysterious voice says:
“Choose only one card…”
Maya takes a deep breath and chooses the WIN card.
Suddenly—
💥 GAME COMPLETED! 💥
The door opens, and Maya escapes from the forest.
Outside, she discovers the game's grand prize: bags of money, gold, and treasure. 💰💎

panels.title: The Discovery
panels.scene_description: Alex, a young adventurer with a backpack, stands before a massive, ancient tree in the middle of a glowing, enchanted forest. He reaches out to touch a dusty, vintage arcade game machine embedded in the tree's roots.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, a young boy named Alex with messy brown hair and a green adventurer's vest standing in a lush, magical forest with glowing plants, looking at a retro arcade machine built into the bark of a giant tree, vibrant colors, dynamic perspective.

panels.title: Level 1: The Shadow Chase
panels.scene_description: Alex sprints through a dark, foggy section of the forest. Behind him, a giant, amorphous shadow monster with glowing red eyes looms, forcing him to jump over gnarled roots and fallen logs.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art, high-action shot of Alex running away from a towering, dark, smoky shadow creature, the forest floor is treacherous with twisted roots, intense motion blur, dramatic shadows, action-packed panel.

panels.title: Level 2: The Mystery House
panels.scene_description: Alex stands inside a dilapidated, eerie house. He is focused on a complex stone puzzle on the wall, his hand hovering over a glowing rune, with the exit door just inches away.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, interior of a creepy abandoned house, Alex looking thoughtful and focused while solving a glowing magical puzzle on a wall, dusty atmosphere, shafts of light coming through cracks in the walls, detailed textures.

panels.title: Level 3: The Final Choice
panels.scene_description: Alex stands in a sterile, white-lit room. On a wooden table before him lie two cards: one labeled 'LOSE' and one labeled 'WIN'. He is reaching out with a steady hand to pick the 'WIN' card.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book close-up, Alex's hand reaching for a card that says 'WIN' in bold letters, another card on the table says 'LOSE', intense lighting, the room is minimalist and mysterious, focused expression on Alex's face.

panels.title: Victory and Reward
panels.scene_description: The forest gate bursts open. Alex emerges back into the sunlight, standing before a massive pile of gold coins, shimmering jewels, and treasure chests, looking triumphant.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art, triumphant scene, Alex standing outside the forest gate, piles of sparkling gold and treasure surrounding him, bright sunshine, celebratory atmosphere, vibrant colors, clear sky.
